summary: Unpacks pixel data from a source buffer (dereference of this+0xDC, always read at +1) into the output buffer a2. When a3 equals 255 the packed block is bulk-copied as full bytes; otherwise it switches on the bits-per-pixel byte at this+0xFB (cases 1, 2, 4, and the default 8+ bpp) and bit-unpacks source pixels, using a3 as a stencil mask that selects which output bits are written.

operations.description: Read the bits-per-pixel byte at this+0xFB; it selects the unpacking width for the non-bulk path.
When a3 equals 255, branch to the bulk-copy path instead of per-pixel unpacking.
Copy the packed block from the source data pointer *(this+0xDC)+1 into the output buffer a2; the copied size is derived from the pixel count at this+0xB8 and the bits-per-pixel value.

For bpp values 1, 2, 4 and the default 8+ case, iterate pixel_count times (dword at this+0xB8), pulling source bits from *(this+0xDC)+1 and merging them into a2 only where the a3 stencil bits are set, advancing the source and output byte pointers when the bit cursor underflows.
Return the last computed byte value (v4); its exact meaning is unresolved.
